summary: Iter22 — Invoice PDF redesign + revised T&C clause #2 backend validation. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter22_invoice_pdf_redesign.py (7 tests) covering structural labels, per-ton+diesel+advance rendering, fixed-mode rendering, revised T&C verbatim, MSME/Udyam presence/absence, and multi-company PDF differentiation. Ran new suite + full iter17 + iter21 regressions serially: 20/20 pass.
critical_code_review_comments: pdf_generator.py build_invoice_pdf() is now ~450 lines within a 1000+ line module. Consider splitting invoice-PDF/LR-PDF into separate modules if the file grows past 700 lines total (currently borderline).
The revised T&C clause is hard-coded as a Python string literal. Consider extracting all T&C clauses to a config/constants module for future edits without touching the layout code.

PDF text extraction shows minor column wrap for 'Load / Product' (e.g., 'Bitumen VG 40' wraps to two lines because 26mm column width is tight). Visually acceptable but the layout could reserve 2-3 more mm for the Load column and steal from Route (38mm) to reduce wrapping for typical product names.
seed_data_creation: Test-prefixed companies (ITER22-CO-A / ITER22-CO-B) with customers/vehicles/drivers/trips/invoices; auto cleaned via cascading DELETE /companies/{id} fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter22 covers Invoice PDF redesign + revised T&C. New pytest file: test_iter22_invoice_pdf_redesign.py. PyMuPDF (fitz) used for text extraction. Note: PDF text may wrap across lines in narrow columns — always normalize whitespace (' '.join(text.split())) before substring assertions on multi-word phrases like 'Bitumen VG 40'. iter17 + iter21 regressions still 100% pass when run serially with -p no:xdist. Company creation uses no X-Company-Id header (creates a new company); trip/invoice creation requires X-Company-Id header to scope. Fixed mode trips must supply fixed_amount and freight_mode='fixed' (rate_per_ton is zeroed by test helper).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration. One test-only issue encountered and fixed: 'Bitumen VG 40' appeared as 'Bitumen VG\n40' in PyMuPDF extraction due to column-wrap in the new tight 'Load / Product' column (26mm). Fixed by normalizing whitespace on both needle and haystack before substring check.
